This '''sensor officer''' served aboard the [[Admiral Ackbar (Victory-class)|''Admiral Ackbar'']] in [[36 ABY]]. An efficient [[Officer/Legends|officer]], she reported the approach of the [[Killik/Legends|Killik]] fleet to [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Nek Bwua'tu]] which precipitated the [[Battle of the Murgo Choke]].
